description: SWATprepR is an R package for preparing inputs to the SWAT+ watershed model. Its authors developed functions during the OPTAIN water-retention project to organise soil, weather, point-source, calibration and GIS information in templates compatible with a SWAT+ setup. Users bring local source observations and spatial layers; outputs are formatted tables and parameters for a configured basin and modelling period. Geographic and temporal coverage therefore follow the supplied catchment data, not a fixed dataset in this package. The README provides example templates, installation instructions and a companion methods paper. It states MIT licensing and offers the code freely on GitHub. Some functions require additional R packages, and SWATprepR is only one stage of the wider SWAT+ workflow; it does not itself run the hydrological simulation. A limitation is that well-formatted inputs remain subject to uncertainty in local soil, weather and management sources. It serves irrigation and flood model preparation. The catalogue's model-fao-cropwat is a distinct crop-water model for comparison; no direct export was tested. No data package was downloaded.
name: SWATprepR hydrological-input preparation package
